observations.body: God is called love, sends the Son, gives the Spirit, and makes abiding love visible through mutual love and confession.
observations.label: God’s unseen love becomes visible among people: action

observations.body: Believers love because God loved first; fear is displaced by mature love.

observations.body: God is love · sent his Son · given us his Spirit · no one has seen God

payload.posture: Read 1 John 4:7–21 as apostolic witness and the end evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The statement “God is love” identifies God’s character and action; it does not reverse into the claim that every thing called love is God.
